//@version=6
indicator("V52 qualifier-startswith-input-source-active", calc_bars_count=32)
sourceText = input.string("abXab", "Source")
patternText = "ab"
value = str.startswith(source=sourceText, str=patternText)
consumer = input.bool(true, "Consumer", active=value)
plot(consumer ? 1 : 0, "CONSUMER")
plot(value ? 1 : 0, "TARGET")
plot(bar_index, "INDEX")
plot(close, "CONTROL_CLOSE")
